name: Baldwin Hills Crenshaw Plaza
address: 3650 West Martin Luther King Jr Boulevard
description: Baldwin Hills Crenshaw Plaza is a historic shopping destination in the heart of South Los Angeles, serving the diverse Crenshaw community since 1947. This enclosed regional mall features major department stores and a variety of retail, dining, and entertainment options that cater to the local multicultural neighborhood. The center has undergone recent renovations to modernize its offerings while maintaining its important role as a community gathering place.
summary: A historic enclosed regional mall serving the vibrant Crenshaw community with diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment options since 1947.
